senses.gloss: m. (צְרֵי I; Syr. צריא, P. Sm. 3441) slit, incision.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 40a:9">Pes. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דאית בהו צ׳ וכ׳</he> as they (the wheat grains) have a slit, the water penetrates them.

<cite ref="Pesachim 40a:9">Ib.</cite> top <he>דילמא … בצִירְיָהּ דחבירתה</he> (Ms. M. <he>בצייריא</he>, read: <he>בצִירְיָיא</he>) maybe one grain moves in boiling and settles in the slit of the other.

<cite ref="Niddah 23a:32">Nidd. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>הא באוכמא הא בצ׳</he> in one case the shape of the black of the eye is meant, in the other, the slit (in which the eye is seated), v. <cite ref="R00319"><he>צִיהֲרָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>צִירְיֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 65b:11">Ab. Zar. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>אגב צִירַיְיהוּ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דאית בהו צירי</he>, read <he>צִירְיֵי</he>) on account of their slits, they are considered as if they were burst open.
